hypothesis: Source-only active learning generates an executable finite-state transducer from black-box I/O and counterexamples, with independent all-length proofs. Unbounded prefix-state functions are outside RC38 bounded relative-read grammar.
method: Classical L*-style Mealy observation table, closure, consistency, counterexample refinement, compiled source interpreter; no human task-specific output labels or reference state graph in learner.

benchmark.independent_proof: Unbounded-length equivalence by BFS of reachable product states; test all possible input continuations at each reachable pair
negative_controls: RC38 local-radius language cannot express unbounded prefix parity
mutated compiled transition must be rejected
benchmark.first_gate: 24/24 independent all-length exact proofs, zero unsupported certifications; report query and CPU costs
benchmark.baseline: Same-access classical L* or equivalent active automata learner has equal rights; do not infer speed advantage
benchmark.degraded: UNKNOWN on budget exhaustion or underdetermination

scientific_limits: Human-authored classical automata-learning algorithm and finite-state interpreter. Does NOT prove neural invention of ISA, Q3 neural unique invention, Q6 truly independent semantic families, Q7 frontier or all-in 10x.
first_score_lock: Lock source before generating scorer and do not tune after FIRST hidden results.
